modules.tool: packages/pi-codex-image-gen/src/tool.ts execute(): collect references -> progress -> existing subscription credential -> per-turn header -> JSON generation/edit client -> data[0] -> saveGeneratedImage -> image+hint; cancellation checked before network and saving; no pending placeholders

endpoints.baseUrl: resolveOpenAiCredentials uses existing Pi openai-codex authentication and its configured base URL, normalized to end with /codex; default https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex
endpoints.headers: bearer Authorization, chatgpt-account-id, originator, User-Agent, x-codex-image-turn-id; additional caller headers preserved; secrets reflected in errors are redacted

retryPolicy.retryOn: HTTP 5xx; timeout (undici UND_ERR_HEADERS_TIMEOUT/UND_ERR_BODY_TIMEOUT); connection errors (ECONNREFUSED, ENOTFOUND, EAI_AGAIN, EHOSTUNREACH, ENETUNREACH, ETIMEDOUT, UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT, TLS certificate codes); other network errors
retryPolicy.backoff: 200 ms × 2^(retry−1) × jitter in [0.9, 1.1), floored to ms (observed 200/400 with jitter fixed at 1.0; 5 attempts ≈ 3.0 s total)
retryPolicy.retryAfter: Retry-After seconds or HTTP-date honored (deadline measured from receipt; observed ≈1 s for `Retry-After: 1`)
retryPolicy.abort: AbortSignal aborts the in-flight fetch and any backoff sleep; the AbortError propagates and Pi reports 'Operation aborted'
retryPolicy.finalError: after the last attempt the last failure's text is returned (Codex returns the last error, not `retry limit reached`)

errorStrings.http: http <status> <IANA reason>: Some("<body, Rust Debug-escaped>") — an empty body yields Some("") exactly as Codex's ReqwestTransport (String::from_utf8(bytes).ok()), not None
errorStrings.decode: stream error: failed to decode image generation response: <serde-style message> (image edit response for edits); missing `created`/`data`/`b64_json`, invalid types, unknown enum variants for background/quality, and JSON syntax errors (Node's JSON.parse message) are covered
errorStrings.noImage: image generation returned no image data (tool-level, when data is empty)

artifact.sanitize: each code point outside [A-Za-z0-9_-] -> '_', empty -> 'generated_image' (observed sess/ion:1 -> sess_ion_1, call/1|fc_2 -> call_1_fc_2)
artifact.base64: strict standard base64 with padding, trimmed, as Codex's BASE64_STANDARD; invalid data counts as a save failure
artifact.saveFailure: result stays successful; hint omitted; details.savedPath absent (observed with a 0o500 root)
artifact.hintText: Generated images are saved to <dir> as <path> by default.\nIf you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.\nThe generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.

resultShape.success: content: [{ type: 'image', data: <b64 as returned>, mimeType: 'image/png' }, { type: 'text', text: <hint> }?]; details: { operation: 'generate'|'edit', background, savedPath? }; no isError
resultShape.emptyB64: treated as success (empty image block, 0-byte file)
resultShape.progress: onUpdate once before the credential check with text 'Generating image…' and details

editClient.signature: ImagesClient.edit(plan: ImageRequestPlan, images: readonly ReferenceImage[], signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ImageResponse>
editClient.referenceImage: { bytes: Uint8Array; mimeType: string; fileName: string }

Node fetch (undici) defaults apply: 300 s headers/body timeouts and a 10 s connect timeout; Codex sets no request timeout. A generation slower than 300 s would surface as `image generation failed: timeout` (FDD §13).
Transport error detail text comes from Node's error causes (format parity only, FDD §9.11).
The brief's 'None when the body is empty' was not implemented because Codex yields Some("") for an empty error body; None only arises when a bounded body read fails, which this client never does.
